title: What a save stores: legs and entry prices only in the reference product, more in ours (G-16-9)
reference_behaviour: A saved strategy keeps its legs (contract, quantity, lot size, side, expiry, type, strike) and initial prices, not IVs, target or manual P&L.
ours: SPEC CHANGE: an extra of ours. REQ-038 AC-1 and AC-5 also store capture times, rules, risk limits and preferences and refuse live fields; copying would drop them. For the owner's batch.
